annotations.title: Get public social posts and comments

description: Search public posts and comments on Bluesky, Hacker News, Mastodon, Lemmy, Reddit, and YouTube, or read the comments on given post addresses. Returns one row layout across platforms. No login. Reddit search needs subreddits in reddit_subreddits (Arctic Shift archive) or the caller's own Serper or Brave key in search_api_key. Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn are not covered. Pay per event on Apify.

include_comments.description: yes or no. Default yes. Each comment is a charged row.

lemmy_instance.description: Host name to search. Default lemmy.world.

mastodon_instance.description: Host name to read hashtags from. Default mastodon.social.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

max_comments_per_post.description: Up to 200. Default 20. YouTube returns its first comment page, about 20.

max_posts_per_platform.description: Up to 500. Default 25. YouTube returns its first results page, about 20 videos.

platforms.description: Any of bluesky, hackernews, mastodon, lemmy, reddit, youtube. Default all 6. Used for queries; a post address picks its own platform.

post_urls.description: Addresses of posts to read comments from, such as your own posts, up to 100. Bluesky, Hacker News, Mastodon, Lemmy, Reddit, and YouTube.

queries.description: Keywords to search on each platform, up to 20. Mastodon reads a query as a hashtag, so crm tools becomes #crmtools.

reddit_route.description: arctic_shift (default): the Arctic Shift archive, free, needs reddit_subreddits. search_key: the caller's own Serper or Brave key, searches all of Reddit. both: both, deduped. When the chosen route fails or cannot run, the actor uses the other one if it can and says so in route_note.

reddit_subreddits.description: Subreddits to search for each query on Reddit, such as sales or r/sales, up to 10. Without your own search key, Reddit is searched through the Arctic Shift archive, which needs a subreddit. Leave empty to search all of Reddit with search_api_key.

search_api_key.description: Optional. The caller's own Serper or Brave Search key, used only to find Reddit posts across all of Reddit. Sent only to that provider; never logged or written to a row.

since_date.description: Only posts from this date, such as 2026-10-01. YouTube gives relative dates only, so YouTube rows are not filtered.

name: get_social_posts_comments
title: Get public social posts and comments
